title: A direct-to-customer store for Kesari Foods
subtitle: Website, WhatsApp ordering and launch marketing for the 2027 season

facts.marketplace_fee: marketplaces take about 25% of each order
facts.past_client: Coastal Spices grew online sales 2.3x in one year

sections.headline: Summary
sections.lede: Kesari Foods sold 18,275 orders this season, most through marketplaces that take about 25% of each order. We propose your own store with WhatsApp ordering, ready before the 2027 season opens.
points: A fast store on your own domain, built for phones
Ordering on WhatsApp, with UPI and cash on delivery
A launch campaign aimed at the 41% of customers who already reorder

sections.headline: What we heard
goals: Sell more boxes directly and keep the margin
Make reordering easy for returning customers
Be ready before the season opens in March
challenges: Orders arrive by phone and WhatsApp with no record
No customer list to market to

sections.headline: What we will deliver

deliverables.name: Online store
deliverables.description: Product pages for every box, cart, UPI and cash on delivery, order emails and an admin to update prices.

deliverables.name: WhatsApp ordering
deliverables.description: An order flow on WhatsApp Business that writes every order to one sheet.

deliverables.name: Launch campaign
deliverables.description: Social posts, a WhatsApp broadcast to past customers and a landing page for ads.

deliverables.name: Training
deliverables.description: Two sessions so your team can run the store and campaigns.

included: One round of changes per deliverable

phases.name: Store and WhatsApp build
phases.outcome: Working store on a test address

sections.headline: Investment

items.description: One day shoot with a partner studio

notes: Hosting and care starts the month the store goes live and can be cancelled with 30 days' notice.

items.result: Online sales grew 2.3x in one year
items.client: Coastal Spices, store and WhatsApp ordering

people.name: Rohan Iyer
people.bio: Leads strategy and is your single point of contact.

people.name: Meera Nair
people.bio: Designs the store and campaign creatives.

sections.headline: Terms
items: Prices exclude courier and payment gateway fees.
You own the store, its content and the customer data.
Either side can end the work with 15 days' written notice; work done is billed.

sections.headline: Next steps
sections.body: Sign below and we will book the discovery workshop for the first week of November.
